name: impact-narrative
title: Metrics with explanatory narrative
description: Contextualized illustrative metrics paired with interpretation and source guidance.

files.content:
MEASURING IMPACT

Put numbers next to their meaning.

From observation to a useful decision

Strong reporting combines a small set of measures with the context needed to interpret them. Explain the source, the time period and what happens next.

The figures in this demo are hypothetical; they are not customer results or product performance claims.

Learn about measurement

Example tasks

24

Example reviewed

18

Example remaining

6

Illustrative numbers only. Replace with sourced, dated data.
